'''Companion Grek''' was a distant satellite dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It lay well beyond [[Firefist|Companion Besh's]] distance of 150,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light years]].<ref name="TEA" /> Companion Grek shared its name with the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|letter]] [[Grek/Legends|grek]]<ref name="Aurebesh">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> and, like all the dwarf satellite galaxies, was classified by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. On the twelfth [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy, Manda: Officer Candidate School Orientation|Officer Candidate School Orientation]] course at the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy]], the [[Teacher/Legends|instructor]] [[Crix Q5 Baobab]] taught the class about the satellite dwarf galaxies, including Companion Grek.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Companion Grek was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
